messages.subject: Return value from isolation
parts:
Hi, 

I came up with problem which bothers me past few days. These are kind of sophisticated and hard to explain. Since selectizeInput(, multiple=TRUE) launch with Shiny 0.9.0 update, I started  upgrading my app. However, this is more general problem for now. I want to populate a vector with values from selectizeInput and alter its values.

new<-NULL # This is my vector which will be populated

  newValues <- reactive({
    new <<- c(new,addItems())     # these values add from another reactive element

    input$updateNew    # this actionButton, which is pressed to assign selected items from selectInput and
    isolate ({
      new <<- input$newItems # adding values which are selected
    })

    return(new)
  })

I am not sure, how explain the problem correctly. Just to state it correctly again: I want reactive element to return one value if button is not pushed. And if button is pressed, I want that value to be overwritten and return overwritten value. However, in this case it wont work.

If more code needed, I could provided simple coded example.

Thanks,

Adam
